_source: The native registry of the power-quests-1 bench run (2026-10-25, kubejs-exported/items.json, format gg-items-1: 34,559 items and 1,402 fluids): every block and fluid id that LuV B1's world noise settings (pack/kubejs/data/grindless/worldgen/noise_settings) name in a "Name" field; each one checked to be in that registry (blocks through their block item, minecraft:lava as a fluid).
_how_it_is_used: tools/analysis/test/luv-worlds.test.mjs fails if a noise settings file names a block or fluid that is not in this list.
Adding a block to a world: check it in a native items.json first, then add it here. Never add an id that is not in a native registry export.
